scope: Analysis ONLY. No model training occurred, no GPU compute was purchased, no training data was formatted. R-5 analysis spend: $0.
question: Whether training is economically justified IF AND ONLY IF the remaining P3 readiness constraints are eventually cleared (d1 scale, d10 itself).
figure_kinds: Every figure carries value_kind: measured (from frozen evidence artifacts), reference (documented public rate with source+date), or assumption (planning number with sensitivity band). Nothing is invented silently.

logged_usage_tokens.note: Sum of usage.tokens across P3_A_QWEN14B, P3_C_PIPELINE_QWEN, P3_PIPELINE_LLAMA, R4_CYCLE_1, R5_TRAJECTORIES (T4-remeasure logged 0: usage not recorded there, so true volume is higher)

evidence_json_bytes.note: ~2 MB: storage cost rounds to $0.00 at reference object-storage rates

cash_spent_to_date_usd.note: All compute local/sunk; all labor unpriced in this $0 project

reference_rates.sensitivity_band: All totals recomputed at 0.5x and 1.5x the reference rate.

scenarios.arithmetic: Rate $2.64 = midpoint of $1.99/$3.29 H100 references; (12+6)h x $2.64 x ~3 runs ~= $142.56

rented_gpu_per_full_eval_usd.note: 1-2 GPU-h at $1.99 on A100-class; CPU is 10-30x slower (assumption band)

cost_per_successful_task.method: Scenario total divided by expected INCREMENTAL held-out closes from the trained model. Expected incremental closes are UNMEASURED (that is the experiment), so this is a parametric break-even table, not a claim.

comparison_vs_cpu_local.cpu_achieved: R2 pipeline 20/20, T4 pipeline 20/20, R5 1/40 (all measured, $0 cash)
comparison_vs_cpu_local.key_point: The $0 baseline already achieves the R2/T4 bars. Training spend must therefore buy what $0 cannot: T4-standalone gains, R5 gains, latency, or generality — all currently unmeasured. Any spend without a measured gain target is expenditure without justification.

break_even_threshold: Training pencils out IFF all of: (a) d1 cleared (>=1000 positives with balance/diversity held); (b) a measured capability gap exists that $0 methods cannot close (held-out shortfall on T4-standalone or R5); (c) projected spend <= $50 (2.8x the Expected point estimate, inside its upper band) for the first experiment. None of (a)/(b) hold today.
economic_conclusion_gates: measured held-out shortfall attributable to scale (not system)
first-experiment spend capped at $50 with a pre-registered gain target
future_training_budget: TBD after R-5 and P3 decision gate
